label.claim_answered: Requiring an all-female chess team to include a male player under the mixed-team rule is unfair.
label.reason: Decision Rule 2: pushes back on a claim favoring women at men's expense by exposing a double standard against men.

reviewers.claim_answered: Requiring an all-female team to include a man is unfair, even though the same rule requires all-male teams to include a woman
reviewers.reason: Addresses the fairness of a rule governing both sexes and rejects the complaint as a double standard; could also be read as rebutting a claim of unfairness to women.

reviewers.claim_answered: The mixed-team rule is unfair because it forces an all-female team to include a man
reviewers.reason: Answers a claim about a rule affecting both sexes, comparing men's and women's obligations; not defending one sex

reviewers.claim_answered: The mixed-team rule is unfair because it forces an all-female team to include a man
reviewers.reason: Pushes back on women's fairness claim, defending men's equal obligation to make room for women

reviewers.claim_answered: An all-female team says the mixed-team rule requiring a male player is unfair to women
reviewers.reason: Rebuts the complaint about a sex-mixing rule by arguing the double standard cuts both ways; the claim concerns both sexes, not one.

reviewers.claim_answered: The rule requiring an all-female chess team to include at least one male player is unfair
reviewers.reason: Pushes back on the complaint that including a man is unfair, exposing a double standard that favors women at men's expense.
